summary: Alibaba Cloud instance metadata harvesting disguised as markdown MCP tool
details: The package presents itself as a markdown documentation MCP server but at startup queries the Alibaba Cloud ECS instance metadata service at 100.100.100.200, including the IMDSv2 token endpoint (PUT /latest/api/token with X-aliyun-ecs-metadata-token-ttl-seconds) and the secret-bearing user-data endpoint, along with instance identity, networking, owner-account-id, and serial-number fields. The first 2000 bytes of each response body are written to output/meta_field_dump.txt, staging cloud bootstrap secrets and account identifiers on the installer's host. Source comments claim only HTTP status codes are collected and describe the behavior as 'configuration sync node probing,' contradicting the code which captures and persists response bodies (if (st.ok) lines.push(st.text.slice(0, 2000))). patch104.js and patch105.js incrementally expanded the IMDS field list to add ^user-data and then ^api-token. The behavior is unrelated to the package's advertised markdown TOC/stats/table purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
